title: US Capitol Building East Front, Washington DC 1949 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A clear black and white photograph from June 4, 1949, featuring the East Front portico of the United States Capitol building in Washington, D.C. The photograph highlights the grand neoclassical Corinthian columns, pediment sculptures, and the prominent statues 'The Discovery of America' and 'The Rescue' on the grand staircases, both of which were removed in 1958 during Capitol expansions. Visitors can be seen standing near the central entrance doorway.
